verdict.rationale: Salv documents its own deployment choice for Monitoring (cloud, private cloud or on-premise). Private cloud or on-premise lets a customer control where data lives, which indirectly addresses residency. There is no documented region selection, residency guarantee, or residency choice for the standard cloud offering, and the deployment statement covers only the Monitoring product. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection for the hosted service, documentation of which regions are available, residency coverage across all Salv products, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Salv Monitoring deploys as cloud, private cloud or on-premise.
